title: Integrative stemness characteristics associated with prognosis and the immune microenvironment in lung adenocarcinoma.
authors: Wang, Han; Wang, Ying; Luo, Wei; Zhang, Xugang; Cao, Ran; Yang, Zhi; Duan, Jin; Wang, Kun
one_liner_zh: 该文分析肺腺癌干性特征与预后及免疫微环境的关系，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: To comprehensively analyze the stemness characteristics related to prognosis and the immune microenvironment in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). METHODS: The OCLR machine learning method was used to calculate the stemness index (mRNAsi) of the LUAD samples. DEGs common between the low mRNAsi, normal, and high mRNAsi groups were screened and the immune-stemness genes were obtained. Then the PPI network was created and enrichment analyses were performed. Moreover, different subtypes based on immune-stemness genes associated with prognosis were identified, and the relationships between LUAD stemness and TIME variables were systematically analyzed, followed by TMB analysis. RESULTS: Patients in the high mRNAsi groups with poor prognosis were screened along with 144 immune-stemness genes. IL-6, FPR2, and RLN3 showed a higher degree in the PPI network. A total of 26 immune-stemness genes associated with prognosis were screened. Two clusters were obtained (cluster 1 and cluster 2). Survival analysis revealed that patients in cluster 2 had a poor prognosis. A total of 12 immune cell subpopulations exhibited significant differences between cluster 1 and cluster 2 (P < 0.05). A total of 10 immune checkpoint genes exhibited significantly higher expression in cluster 1 (P < 0.05) than in cluster 2. Further, the TMB value in cluster 2 was higher than that in cluster 1 (P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: Immune-stemness genes, including L-6, FPR2, and RLN3, might play significant roles in LUAD development via cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction, neuroactive ligand‒receptor interaction, and the JAK‒STAT pathway. Immune-stemness genes were related to tumor-infiltrating immune cells, TMB, and expression of immune checkpoint gene.
abstract_zh: 背景：全面分析肺腺癌（LUAD）中与预后及免疫微环境相关的干性特征。方法：采用OCLR机器学习方法计算LUAD样本的干性指数（mRNAsi）。筛选低mRNAsi组、正常组和高mRNAsi组之间的共同差异表达基因（DEGs），并获取免疫-干性基因。随后构建PPI网络并进行富集分析。此外，基于与预后相关的免疫-干性基因识别不同亚型，系统分析LUAD干性与TIME变量之间的关系，随后进行TMB分析。结果：筛选出预后不良的高mRNAsi组患者，共获得144个免疫-干性基因。IL-6、FPR2和RLN3在PPI网络中表现出较高的连接度。共筛选出26个与预后相关的免疫-干性基因。获得两个聚类（聚类1和聚类2）。生存分析显示，聚类2中的患者预后较差。聚类1和聚类2之间共有12个免疫细胞亚群存在显著差异（P < 0.05）。聚类1中共有10个免疫检查点基因的表达显著高于聚类2（P < 0.05）。此外，聚类2中的TMB值高于聚类1（P < 0.05）。结论：免疫-干性基因（包括IL-6、FPR2和RLN3）可能通过细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用、神经活性配体-受体相互作用及JAK-STAT通路在LUAD发展中发挥重要作用。免疫-干性基因与肿瘤浸润免疫细胞、TMB及免疫检查点基因表达相关。
